description: Watch state for Lawrence Noble 1990 Killian Industries bronze Yoda statue (limited edition of 50, ~8-11in, made for Empire Strikes Back 10th anniversary). Excludes the unrelated 31-inch life-size Yoda statue.

excluded_seen.title: Lot #411 - William Plumb Collection: Lawrence Noble Original Small-Scale Bronze Yoda Statue
excluded_seen.reason: Noble's own original cast ('YODA #1'), not a numbered piece from the Killian Industries edition of 50; sold $10,080.

excluded_seen.title: Lot #450 - William Plumb Collection: Limited-Edition Lawrence Noble Bronze Yoda Statue Artist Proof
excluded_seen.reason: Artist Proof 3/6, a separate 6-piece proof run, not the commercial edition of 50; est. $30,000-$60,000.

excluded_seen.title: Star Wars Yoda 31" Bronze Sculpture by Lawrence Noble (Lucasfilm, c. 2005)
excluded_seen.reason: This is the excluded 31-inch life-size statue, not the 1990 edition-of-50 piece.

notes: No active or sold eBay/Heritage/Propstore listing found matching the actual 1990 Killian Industries edition-of-50 bronze (~8-11in). A plausible match (numbered 15/50, 'Empire Strikes Back 10th Anniversary 1980-1990' bronze) was seen on Etsy, which is outside this watch's tracked sources (eBay/Heritage/Propstore only), so it is not added to 'items'.
